svg.aria-label: E-2 Pad box power and arming
svg.title: E-2 Pad box power and arming
svg.desc: Battery, fuses, main switch, K1 changeover relay, arm key, watchdog and AND gate.
svg.text: E-2 · Pad box: power and arming
K1 is shown SAFE (coil off): PAD+ is tied to ground. Three things must all be true to energise it: key in ARM, watchdog fed, firmware ARM_EN.
also VDRV: the TC4427 gate drivers are powered from PAD+,
so no gate can turn on unless K1 is ARMED.
HB = HEARTBEAT GPIO, toggled on each valid packet
• Siren: Floyd Bell 12 V, low-side MOSFET Q8 from SIREN GPIO
• Beacon: WS2812 16-ring on +5 V, data via 74AHCT125 from BEACON GPIO
• Anemometer: Adafruit 1733, 12 V supply, 0.4–2.0 V out → ADS1115 #2 AIN3
• Battery voltage: INA228 VBUS; K1 sense: PAD+ → 100 k/22 k → GPIO
• Charge port: Powerpole pair to BT1 via F0 (charge with S1 OFF)
• TVS 1.5KE18A across +12 SW to GND at the board input
• All logic grounds meet at the BATT− side of RS1 (one point)
Key OFF → no coil current (hardware). Watchdog starves → U3 low → Q7 off.
Firmware drops ARM_EN → Q7 off. K1 at rest → PAD+ = 0 V and no gate drive.
S1 OFF → everything off; PAD+ still tied to GND through K1 87a.
